 Order

This is first bail application filed by the applicant under Section 483 of BNSS, 2023 for grant of regular bail in relation to FIR No.157/2021, dated 07.03.2021, registered at Police Station- Bagsewania, District Bhopal (M.P.) for commission of offence punishable under Sections 420, 409 of IPC.

Applicant is in detention since 16.12.2024.
2.

As per the prosecution story, a complaint was made by Ramdev Prajapati alleging that he had deposited Rs.80,000/- with Suvidha Land Developers India Limited on the basis of allurement and assurance that same will be returned as double after 5 years, but thereafter Company closed its Offices and cheated him and other innocent investors more than Crores of rupees by closing its Offices.
In the course of the investigation, applicant along with other has been found to be a person involved in the affairs of the Company.

3. Learned counsel for the applicant has submitted that the applicant NEUTRAL CITATION NO.
2025:MPHC-JBP:12483 2 MCRC-2709-2025 was neither the Director nor Managing Director of the Company.
He was simply a share holder and he has nothing to do with the embezzlement and fraud committed by the Company.
Therefore, it is prayed that the applicant may be released on bail pending the trial.

sentences.text: On the other hand, learned counsel for the State has opposed the prayer for grant of bail to the applicant.

5. On going through the documents Annexure A/4 to A/10 it is revealed that at the relevant time Rajneesh Dutta, Vinod Kumar Shankhwar, Rajendra Karan Rajpoot, Pardeshi Ram and Jagdish Bisvas were working as Director of the Company.
On perusal of the documents filed by the counsel for the applicant, it revealed that the applicant was simply a share holder.

Therefore, having taken into consideration all the facts and circumstances of the case, but without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, I am of the view that it is a case in which further pre-trial detention of the applicant is not warranted.
Consequently, this bail application under 483 of BNSS, 2023 for grant of bail filed on behalf of applicant, stands allowed.

6. It is directed that applicant - Ramsawroop Sahu be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.1,00,000/- (Rupees One Lac only) with two solvent sureties of Rs.50,000/-
each to the satisfaction of the trial Court, for his regular appearance before the trial Court during trial with a condition that he shall remain present before the concerned Court on all the dates fixed by it during trial.

He shall abide by all the conditions enumerated under Section 480(3) of BNSS,
2023.
7.
This order shall be effective till the end of the trial.

However, in NEUTRAL CITATION NO.
2025:MPHC-JBP:12483 3 MCRC-2709-2025 case of bail jump and breach of any of the conditions of bail
, it shall become ineffective.

Certified copy as per rules (DINESH KUMAR PALIWAL) JUDGE Vin**
